A polygon defined directly by its vertices

shape_raw.Rd

shape_raw is the simplest drawable: the user supplies x and y coordinates directly, and points is computed trivially from them. It is most often produced by convert()ing a more complex drawable (e.g. a shape_blob or shape_twist) down to its raw vertices.

Usage

shape_raw(x, y, ...)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector of x coordinates.

y

Numeric vector of y coordinates.

...

Arguments passed to style().

See also

Other 2D shapes: shape_bezier(), shape_bezier_ribbon(), shape_blob(), shape_circle(), shape_ribbon(), shape_twist()
